scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace=server
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client
